package: @astryxdesign/cli

## search()

Unified ranked search across components, hooks, docs, templates, and themes.

The single "I'm looking for X" entry point across every content domain. Matching and scores are keyword + fuzzy (not embeddings). Between score bands results keep the lexical order, whose domain priority can put a weaker component, hook, template, or theme above a stronger doc, and a query that is an entry's exact name answers with that entry first. Inside a band, fixed weights order the matches, so a description match can lead a keyword match in the same band (55–99 holds both). A component's usage guidance (its best practices) is indexed one tier below its description, so the words a reader types still find it. In global mode: with `cwd` outside a project, items from integrations installed next to this CLI package globally are searched too, and theme results name no step that adds a theme to an app; inside a project, only the project's own integrations count. See `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global` and `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global/computer-integrations`.

```ts
search(query: string, options?: SearchOptions): Promise<SearchResponse>
```

Import it from `@astryxdesign/cli/api`.

Parameter          | Type                                                      | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
`query` (required) | `string`                                                  |         | Free-text search term.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
`options.type`     | `'component' \| 'hook' \| 'doc' \| 'template' \| 'theme'` |         | Restrict results to a single domain.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
`options.limit`    | `number`                                                  | 20      | Maximum number of results.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
`options.cwd`      | `string`                                                  |         | Directory to resolve @astryxdesign/core from: the project's installed Core, else, outside a project or in a project with nothing installed, the Core of the release that answers, installed into the per-user cache first when needed. A docs-only or themes-only search (`type: 'doc'` or `type: 'theme'`) does not need it. A search with no `type` covers the docs and themes alone only when that Core cannot be obtained, and then says so in `meta.partial`.

Returns  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
-------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
`search` | The query echoed back, `matchCount` (how many candidates matched in total, before `limit`), plus a ranked SearchResultEntry[] bounded by `limit`: each has domain, name, score, reason, description, and follow-up command, plus `import` for components and hooks, `title` for docs, `displayName` and `kind` for templates, and `displayName` for themes. A deprecated component's result also carries `deprecated`, `{replacement, description}` from its doc: the name of the component to use instead and the modernization route. A doc result is the smallest part that answers: one section (with `section`, and a command that reads only it), one docs-tree route, or a topic, whose command lists its sections. `parent` is the command that opens the level above it: the section list of its topic, the namespace a tree node sits in, the topic level (Guides or Foundations) for a flat topic, or the topic list for a top-level namespace. Every doc result also carries `package`, the npm package that authored it (for a section, the package its file came from). A theme result is one theme you can import: `name` is its slug, its command is `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add <slug>` (outside a project, where there is no app to add it to, `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme eject <slug>`), and `package` is the npm package that ships it (`@astryxdesign/cli` for the CLI's own themes). When a search with no `type` could not obtain @astryxdesign/core, `meta.partial` is `{skipped, reason}`: the domains it skipped (`component`, `hook`, `template`) and why; the results are the docs and themes, and text mode prints one line on standard error.

Throws                     | When                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
-------------------------- | -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
`ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT`     | the query is empty, --type is unknown, or --limit is not a positive integer                                                                                                                                                                                      
`ERR_CORE_NOT_FOUND`       | @astryxdesign/core cannot be found from the cwd, and `type` names a domain that reads it: `component`, `hook`, or `template`                                                                                                                                     
`ERR_VERSIONS_UNAVAILABLE` | `type` names a domain that reads @astryxdesign/core, and outside a project, or in a project with nothing installed, the Core of the release that answers cannot be installed into the per-user cache; a search with no `type` answers with `meta.partial` instead

Find a component:
```ts
const r = await search('button');
```

Restrict + limit:
```ts
await search('data table', {type: 'template', limit: 5});
```

`npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 search` runs it. Read it with `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/search`.
